faqs.q: What is included in every session?
faqs.a: Direction throughout, professional studio lighting, hand editing on each delivered frame and a private online gallery for downloads.

faqs.q: How are weddings and events priced?
faqs.a: Coverage is quoted per day based on your timeline, locations and the number of photographers required. Get in touch for a tailored estimate.

faqs.q: When do we receive the images?
faqs.a: A preview set arrives within 48 hours, with the full hand-edited gallery following within two weeks for sessions.
Yes. Additional edited images from your session can be purchased individually after you have seen the gallery.
